options.title: Prologue | Demon X Angel
options.prompt:
For centuries, Heaven and the Underworld existed apart.
Angels called demons corrupted. Demons called angels arrogant.

Then came the Accord.

The ancient agreement created Demon X Angel Academy, a place where the children of Heaven and Hell could study together in the hope that the next generation might succeed where their ancestors had failed.

It wasn't exactly peaceful.

Arguments between demons and angels were common. So were rivalries, misunderstandings, competitions, and the occasional magical incident that required Raphael to repair someone's injuries.

Still, students went to class. They joined clubs. They complained about homework. They fell in love, made friends, made enemies, and slowly discovered that the person sitting across from them wasn't always what their faction had taught them to expect.

Today marks the beginning of another academic year.

The academy's enormous gates stand open beneath a clear morning sky. Angels descend from gleaming carriages while demons arrive through shimmering portals, their voices mixing across the courtyard.

And among the crowd stands someone new.

You.

Whatever your origin, whatever expectations come with your bloodline, today is the first page of your story. Orientation begins in 15 minutes.

options.title: Prologue | Free Mode
options.prompt:
Demon X Angel Academy was never meant for people like you.

The academy was founded under the Accord to educate the next generation of Heaven and the Underworld together. Its halls belong to angels and demons, its traditions shaped by centuries of supernatural society.

Yet somehow, you have found yourself here.

Perhaps you were hired as a teacher. Perhaps you're an ordinary human who somehow crossed a boundary you weren't supposed to. Maybe you're a monster from somewhere beyond Heaven and Hell, a wandering spirit, a magical creature, or even a familiar belonging to one of the students.

There are countless ways you could have arrived.

The important thing is that you're here now.

Nobody seems entirely sure what to make of you.

For better or worse, Demon X Angel Academy has made room for one more.

Your story begins here.
